text: Make a day of it, and chuck everything all round.” “It would be rather nice,” said Virginia, smiling at him. “Virginia, you’re a darling. Tell me, you do like me rather, don’t you? Better than other people.” “Bill, I adore you. If I had to marry some one—simply had to—I mean if it was in a book and a wicked mandarin said to me ‘Marry some one or die by slow torture,’ I should choose you at once—I should indeed.
